game.name: Turbo: Super Stunt Squad (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Turbo: Super Stunt Squad is an action/racing game available on the Xbox 360. Control one of the heroes from the movie of the same name, each with their own driving style, tricks and special skills. You can customise your character, find shortcuts on the tracks, and perform amazing stunts using the scenery to gain an advantage in the race. You can also play with a friend in cooperation.
